0022600210.text: The Warriors (7-3, on a seven-game winning streak and 5-1 at home) host the Pelicans (4-5, 1-2 on the road, coming off a loss) in their 11th game of the 2026-27 season, with Golden State 2nd in the Pacific, one game back, and 4th in the West while New Orleans sits 11th in the West. The teams have not met yet this season, and Golden State won the 2025-26 series 2-1, though its most recent meeting was a 113-109 loss in New Orleans on February 24, 2026. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise).
